summary: After a Stop, the stopped tree and the stopped list now mark every figure the store reports unfinished as 'at least', up to the root, using the store's AtLeast bound and never the rolled figure. A row with no mark draws what it always drew. One guard, ScanResult.MarksAtLeast, gates both surfaces, so a completed scan shows 'at least' nowhere. AtLeastFigures is now a standalone struct with an internal constructor, so the window can only word a bound the store made. The Size and On disk cells are 102 DIP wide, the tree header's sentence about the figures is drawn in full at 880 px, and only the size clause of the two list headers changed. New: window cases T-013 and T-014, four WindowMutants entries, Core facts, and a seam corpus. All pass: full suite 1111/1111, the existing window cases, WindowMutants -Mutant All (16/16), and the rules harness (175 rows as recorded, engine taad_v3 0ccf00f). The published exe run on C:\Program Files\dotnet stopped at 'shared\' drew the right marks; every bound reads 'at least 0 bytes' there, as Q-292 expects.

obligations.how: T-013 checks that m-mid (listed, folders below it never listed, depth 1) and the root (depth 0) draw 'at least' in both cells with no note; the Core fact AFolderWithNoFileBelowIsMarkedThroughAnUnreadFolderBelowIt covers the arm where only NotListedAtOrBelow marks the folder.

T-013 checks b-listed (rolled 212 KB, bound 0) draws 'at least 0 bytes' and that no row whose bound differs from its rolled figure draws the rolled one; the TreeAtLeastRolled mutant turns those lines red.
T-013 checks b-listed\b1.bin, a file with its size check pending, draws 'at least 0 bytes' in both cells; the NoTreeAtLeast mutant turns that line red.

The hook's cell-fit line measures 'at least 1,023 bytes' (101.26 DIP) against the Size and On disk cell widths (102), and every drawn figure's layout clip and text width are read; the NarrowAtLeastCells mutant (Size cell back to 80) fails exactly the cell-fit line.

T-013 walks the ancestors of every unread or marked row up to the root and requires 'at least' on each (419 checked); StoppedTopLevelTests checks on every Stop of a ragged sweep that an unread or unfinished entry has an unfinished parent.
T-013 requires a-empty, b-listed\empty, b-listed\denied and c-prefix (5,000 listed folders, no file below) to read store-final and to draw the store's rolled figures with no word.

T-013 compares the stopped list's rows with the depth-1 tree rows by name: two marked (b-listed Done, m-mid StoppedPartway) with bound and 'N files' equal to the store's and the tree cells; a-empty and c-prefix equal storeRolled with no word; p00-p04 NotRead unworded.

StoppedTopLevelTests compares every public property of the snapshot and of each row except AtLeast by reflection (the property list is pinned, so a new property must be named); ARebuiltRowKeepsEveryPropertyItHad rebuilds rows carrying Revised, FailedKind and UnreadableBelow; FiguresOf is checked on marked rows from Stops in the listing and in the size checks.
StoppedTopLevelTests requires StoppedTopLevel() to be a new object whenever a row is marked and the scanner's own object when none is, and the published snapshot never to be changed.
ANoStoreToMarkIsReturnedAsItIsAndNeverRead: a Stop before the root (Count 0), RootUnreadable, Refused, Completed, and a hand-built empty store all give MarksAtLeast false and the snapshot unread.
T-014: m-big stopped at 'm-big\' with 9,991 unread children and 9 realized rows drawing 'at least'; cold open 77.0 ms, warm 1.7-2.1 ms, 25 rows built, all under 500 ms.

T-013 run 2 scans the same tree to the end: no row, property, drawn text or hook line says 'at least'. L-001, L-002, L-004, T-010, T-011, T-012 and T-001/2/4/5/6/7/8/9, S-001..S-009, K-001..K-003, L-003 pass; the only moved expectations are the two list header constants (Q-290).
WindowMutants NoTreeAtLeast (Bound never read) and NoListAtLeast (ending shows TopLevel) each fail exactly their pinned T-013 lines; -Mutant All passes 16/16.

M1: the tree header's drawn sentence promises only sizes ('Sizes marked at least may grow; unmarked sizes are final.') and the rest says order, shares and bars are by space on disk as listed; T-013 checks the exact header and that no sentence calls shares final.

Stopped at shared\: 29 rows read, 25 store-unfinished all drew the bound in full, 4 unread rows drew no figure, 0 ancestors missing 'at least' up to the root, root row 'at least 0 bytes'; the list showed sdk/packs/host Done but marked 'at least 0 bytes ... in at least 7,204 files and at least 1,476 folders', shared StoppedPartway, swidtag/templates NotRead unworded; list header with the new size clause; tree header 108 of 200 characters drawn; widest figure 101.26 DIP in a 102 cell. deviations: TopLevelSnapshot.WithRows builds the copy through the snapshot's one existing constructor, not through the private copy constructor the design named. tests/bugs/SL-100 finds the snapshot's constructor by reflection as the only non-public one (.Single()), and a second one failed 28 of its 29 facts (lesson #466: the design's consumer check missed tests/bugs). Same behaviour: every field kept, rows cloned.

Added beyond the design, to discharge O-018 and O-019/O-020: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/AtLeastSeamCorpus.json and AtLeastSeamTests (a reflection and IL census, including a text check of the window's session wiring), docs/design/SL-113-stopped-at-least.md, and plant rows S88-S90/P38-P40 in eng/rules-harness/plants.json (lesson #330).

The hook's atLeastRealized counts only the opened folder's own realized rows, not every realized row, so the marked root and m-big rows cannot satisfy T-014's void rule by themselves. The cell-fit line is emitted at the end of any Walk (not on WALK=0 runs).

T-013's NarrowAtLeastCells mutant fails only the cell-fit line, so no MayFail is declared for C1's clipping clause: the stopped fixture's bounds are all 'at least 0 bytes' (79.25 DIP), which fits in 80. The cell-fit line is what catches the widest figure.

The design's rule list had attempt 1's 'an at least figure is never the rolled or listing figure' removed (it matches AtLeastSize(, which no longer exists); the two settled rules kept and given new 'because' text, and the second states that its two patterns are a tripwire with the IL census as the closure.

The rule-2 yaml entries sit in .taad/fitness.yaml as the engine appended them in an earlier attempt and as I rewrote them; if the engine appends the declared architecture_rules again at merge the two names may duplicate.

Check the 102 DIP cells (0.74 DIP margin at 125% DPI) and the tree header's drawn sentence at 100% and 150% DPI and with larger text, which needs a person to change the display scale.
Whole-C: completed scan confirming no NotListed bit survives completion (the blocked spike); criterion 6 on a real drive rests on it, and MarksAtLeast is what stands in front of it meanwhile.
Contain the ending's StoppedTopLevel() call under Q-071's per-pass wrap (review m2, deferred): clear the list and say 'Couldn't show this view', never fall back to the unmarked rows.
Q-276: the stopped list's NotRead row still draws '0 bytes (0 bytes on disk) in 0 files and 0 folders'; its intended wording is undecided.

UnfinishedTests.StopsInTheSizeChecksMarkWhatAPendingCheckCouldChange(workers: 4) failed once in a full-suite run under load ('gb' final with the listing's on-disk figure) and passed every other time; look at whether the 4-worker cutoff has a timing race.
